title: Installation
description: The device begins active service - implanted in a patient, or commissioned into operation at a facility. One event covers both: MDR Article 18's Implant Card records exactly this pairing (UDI-DI, UDI-PI) for implantable devices, and capital equipment undergoes an equivalent installation/commissioning qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) before first use. No field for a patient exists anywhere in this schema or profile - party names the implanting or commissioning facility as a business, never a person (spec Sec.5, Sec.9).

context.description: implant: an implantable device begins service inside a patient. commission: capital or reusable equipment begins service at a facility.

qualification.description: For commission: which qualification stages were completed before first use.
